About the event

Share something special with the Frenz at the Frenz Group PowerPoint Night!

We wanted to do this just for a fun night out amongst our friends, to give everyone a chance to talk about something they are passionate about and to celebrate each other and our creativity! We’re hosting it at a venue to make the night feel special but we hope it feels intimate and safe amongst close friends.

Present on anything you want! Share rare knowledge, teach us a skill, tell us a story, let us deep into your inner world, make us laugh… We can help you come up with a topic if you would like – just note it in the RSVP form!

You do not need to make a presentation to attend!

You can give a shared presentation with others!

Dinner will be served!
